name: Sigakhwa Click-to-Ask
description: Turns boxes of a Mermaid diagram into one-tap follow-up questions. When an assistant reply carries a ```sigakhwa-actions block, each bound box sends its prepared prompt once, into the same conversation and profile, through WebUI's own send path. Selecting text in a reply offers four quick asks: explain simply, check the evidence, visualize, compare alternatives.
author: johnDEFI
